scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the class hooks off vs candidate with the hooks on), 12864 isolated CPU pairs for 51 functions of CTrain (19), CPlane (14) and CBike (18), zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored, layout check ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture in both legs (fake 0xA18-byte vehicles in a fake 8-slot vehicle pool that replaces the real pool pointer 0xB74494 and is restored, fake vtable with traced slots, 32-byte guards) and compares: the full hash of every vehicle, the guard, the return value, the x87 control word and the trace of outgoing calls with arguments. Virtual functions are called through the EXE vtable slot (with the hook on it points to the DLL). Traced stubs, which get NO credit: CWorld::Add/Remove, FindPlayerVehicle, CWorld::ProcessVerticalLine, CTrain::FindPositionOnTrackFromCoors, operator delete/delete[] (Shutdown only), CWorld::ClearScanCodes, TrainHitStuff, CVehicle::Render, CAutomobile::OpenDoor, CVehicle::SetModelIndex, CClumpModelInfo::FillFrameArray, CBike::ProcessRiderAnims, GetFirstObject, CAutomobile::CAutomobile, CVehicleModelInfo::GetWheelPosn, CEntity::GetColModel, CPlaceable::SetOrientation, RwFrameGetLTM, CPhysical::ApplyMoveSpeed/ApplyTurnSpeed/SkipPhysics/CheckCollision/ApplyMoveForce/ApplyTurnForce, cBuoyancy::ProcessBuoyancy, CBike::CalculateLeanMatrix and DoHeadLightBeam (Render only) and the RenderState pointers of RwGlobals. Limits: OUT of the bench and with NO credit: CTrain::ProcessControl (full train physics), CBike::Constructor, CBike::Destructor, CBike::DamageKnockOffRider (corrected in source but not benched: needs fake peds, events and CEventGroup::Add) and CBike::ProcessEntityCollision. CBike::ProcessBuoyancy is compared only without driver and passengers (m_pDriver = null, m_nMaxPassengers = 0); CBike::GetComponentWorldPosition only with present nodes (the missing-node path differs in logging); CPlane::OpenDoor with the dead-code global flag 0xC1CAFC off. Masked bench noise: in CBike::CalculateLeanMatrix the padding of the lean matrix (+0xC/+0x1C/+0x2C/+0x3C), which is stack garbage in the EXE (0x59BE30 temp + rep movs); CMatrix comparisons ignore the padding between vectors. Fixture floats are finite or quiet NaN. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source corrected to what the EXE does before the approved run (uncommitted at the time; see reversing/VehWave2/README.md for addresses): see source_corrections_before_run. Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.
